crime_highlights: police found a package in the residence which contained approximately 45 grams of cocaine, 10.9 grams of heroin fentanyl, and 5.5 grams of methamphetamine
They also located a Glock handgun which was loaded and two loaded magazines and additional cartridges
I found both offenders to be in possession of the loaded firearm and the drugs in the residence
Mr. Perkins also sold a relatively small amount of cocaine to an undercover officer on two occasions
rationale_highlights: The Gladue report prepared for Ms. Bransford's sentencing indicates that many of the Gladue factors are present in this case
Her great‑grandfather survived Indian residential school and grew up without his culture
She grew up without her indigenous culture or spiritual teachings
after considering the mitigating and aggravating factors and applying the Gladue principles, the appropriate total sentence in this case is three years
note: Court only says Gladue principles applied to reach three years; no explicit culpability reduction.

crime_highlights: He frequently engaged in the following behaviour towards her: leaning in close trying to kiss her
K.J. was 13 when these incidents began
Both Crown and defence counsel acknowledged the impact on young persons of inappropriate sexual touching is psychologically traumatic
the offences made her feel uncomfortable and awkward and gave her general stress and anxiety
She was fearful of his unexpected visits, which were frequent
rationale_highlights: I find that B.S.'s Aboriginal heritage is central to who he is as a person

B.S. has been fortunate on a personal level to escape the abuse and addiction problems that have been recognized to be part of the negative and harmful legacy imposed on Aboriginal people because of colonialism
he could only be raised within his traditional culture by being separated from the majority of his community
I do not agree that proportionality can be achieved with a conditional sentence, even when emphasizing the importance of his heritage and the Gladue factors
having specific regard to the ties to his community, I find a sentence of 12 months' incarceration, and two years' probation is appropriate
note: Victim initials appear in one highlight; heritage tempers but does not avoid custody.

crime_highlights: They were fighting with their fists, then both of them picked up chairs and were trying to hit each other with them
Mr. Jackson had Mr. Alphonse on the ground and was beating him with a chair
Mr. Alphonse immediately got up from the floor and, using his own knife, slashed Mr. Jackson on the back and stabbed him twice in the left side
Mr. Jackson fell to the ground.
rationale_highlights: Mr. Alphonse has certainly been impacted by intergenerational trauma.

the first 17 years of Mr. Alphonse's life was in a home that was intermittently impacted by poverty, abuse, both physical and verbal, instability, criminal behaviour, a lack of education, and the normalization of substance abuse
He reports facing racism, including threats, throughout middle school and high school.
note: Court never states effect of Gladue factors on sentence; suspended sentence rests on near self-defence.
